name: wpvibe
description: Connect WPVibe to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use WPVibe MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect WPVibe to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with self-hosted WordPress management using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my WPVibe workspace.
Find anything in WPVibe that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review self-hosted WordPress management in WPVibe.
